title: etale kummer derived unit
statement: Let n>0, A a finite commutative ring killed by n, Z a scheme on which n is invertible, and i:D→Z an effective Cartier closed immersion. The normalized etale Kummer class G_m→forget(A_Z(1))[1] is a degree-one unbounded scalar unit [def-sfb-cartier-reduction-data, def-sp-derived-scalar-ext-unit].

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: Apply scalarUniversal_derivedUnit to each SupportedDerivedScalarUnit hypothesis. This API theorem gives the raw unbounded exact-functor unit without unfolding concrete derived localization data, and preserves the current ordinary supported-scalar definition verbatim.

For R=ULift(Z/n), the ordinary root map is an isomorphism. Apply the residue Kummer unit theorem through this isomorphism to the etale Kummer sequence. The coefficient clause of the existing ordinary supported Cartier Kummer theorem supplies the normalized derived unit R_Z(1)→Res(A_Z(1)). Compose the two scalar units and identify composite coefficient forgetting with direct forgetting. At a root z the composite root map sends z to 1 tensor z, by the pure tensor normalization at a=1. Yoneda associativity then identifies its Ext representative with the published Kummer unit.

theorem etale_kummer_derived_unit
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hA : (n : A) = 0) {D Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion i]
